```{r}
data_experimental <- data[data$Condition == "expt", ]


library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Rescale to 0-1 range
data_experimental <- data_experimental %>%
  mutate(
    confidence = confidence / 100,
    self = appraisal_SELF_cond1 / 100,
    other = appraisal_OTHER_cond1 / 100
  )


data_experimental <- data_experimental %>%
  mutate(reinterpretation = confidence - self + other) %>%
  mutate(reinterpretation_z = as.numeric(scale(reinterpretation)))


data_experimental$semantic_distance <- 1 - data_experimental$cosine_sim_avg_inputs_BERT_context_miniLM_L6

data_experimental <- data_experimental %>%
  mutate(
    Fisher_R_Value = atanh(R_Value),
    neural_shift = 1-Fisher_R_Value,
  )

```

## Getting the whole brain stat (going to extract just the linear poly!)
```{r}
data_experimental <- data_experimental %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(reinterpretation),
    !is.na(neural_shift),
    !is.na(semantic_distance),
  )

#WHOLE BRAIN MODEL:
model <- lmer(reinterpretation ~ neural_shift*poly(semantic_distance,3) + (1|stim_file) + (1|Subject) +(1|Node_Number), data=data_experimental)
tab_model(model)

```

### marignal slopes thing to get the comparison!
```{r}
library(marginaleffects)

# Refit with polynomial semantic distance
model <- lmer(
  reinterpretation ~ neural_shift * semantic_distance +
    (1|stim_file) + (1|Subject) + (1|Node_Number),
  data = subset_data
)

# Estimated marginal slope of neural_shift at low (0.25) and high (0.75) semantic distance
slopes_by_distance <- slopes(
  model,
  variables = "neural_shift",
  newdata = datagrid(semantic_distance = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75))
)
slopes_by_distance

# Formal test: is the slope at high distance significantly different from the slope at low distance?
hypotheses(
  slopes(
    model,
    variables = "neural_shift",
    newdata = datagrid(semantic_distance = c(0.25, 0.75))
  ),
  hypothesis = "b1 = b2"
)

```



#Same -- pairwise mutual adjustment!- for Supplementary figure! 
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)          
library(ggpattern)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

# Recreate df_wide 
networks_of_interest <- c("DefaultB", "ContA", "ContB", "SalVentAttnB")

df_agg <- data_experimental %>%
  filter(Network_17N %in% networks_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(Subject, stim_file, Network_17N) %>%
  summarise(
    neural_shift      = mean(neural_shift, na.rm = TRUE),
    semantic_distance = first(semantic_distance),
    reinterpretation  = first(reinterpretation),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_wide <- df_agg %>% #because going to use the mean shift! 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Network_17N,
    values_from = neural_shift,
    names_glue  = "{Network_17N}_ns"
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(
    DefaultB_ns, ContA_ns, ContB_ns, SalVentAttnB_ns,
    reinterpretation, semantic_distance
  ))

# 1. Network labels + colors 
network_labels <- c(
  "DefaultB"     = "DMN-B",
  "ContA"        = "FPN-A",
  "ContB"        = "FPN-B",
  "SalVentAttnB" = "VAN-B"
)

comparison_networks <- c("ContA", "ContB", "SalVentAttnB")

network_colors <- c(
  "DMN-B" = "#dc2d2c",
  "FPN-A" = "#8a5914",
  "FPN-B" = "#b8761b",
  "VAN-B" = "#f028e9"
)

# 2. get_coef 
## LINEAR: the interaction term is "<col>:semantic_distance" (either ordering).
get_coef <- function(model, col, label, model_label, fill_group) {
  wanted <- c(paste0(col, ":semantic_distance"),
              paste0("semantic_distance:", col))

  result <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term %in% wanted) %>%
    mutate(network = label, model = model_label, fill_group = fill_group)

  cat("\n──", label, "|", model_label, "──\n")
  if (nrow(result) > 0) {
    cat("  β =", round(result$estimate, 4),
        "| SE =", round(result$std.error, 4),
        "| t =", round(result$statistic, 3),
        "| p =", round(result$p.value, 4), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  term is missing!!!! :\n    ",
        paste(tidy(model, effects = "fixed")$term, collapse = "\n     "), "\n")
  }
  result
}

#  3. Fit  models 
m_dmnb_alone <- lmer(
  reinterpretation ~ DefaultB_ns * semantic_distance +
    (1|Subject) + (1|stim_file),
  data = df_wide
)

dmnb_unadj <- get_coef(m_dmnb_alone, "DefaultB_ns", "DMN-B",
                       "Unadjusted", "DMN-B_Unadjusted")

results <- map_dfr(comparison_networks, function(net) {
  other_col   <- paste0(net, "_ns")
  other_label <- unname(network_labels[net])

  cat("\n════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("DMN-B vs", other_label, "\n")
  cat("════════════════════════════════\n")

  m_dmnb_adj <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(
      "reinterpretation ~ DefaultB_ns * semantic_distance + ",
      other_col, " * semantic_distance + (1|Subject) + (1|stim_file)"
    )),
    data = df_wide
  )

  m_other_alone <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(
      "reinterpretation ~ ", other_col, " * semantic_distance + ",
      "(1|Subject) + (1|stim_file)"
    )),
    data = df_wide
  )

  m_other_adj <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(
      "reinterpretation ~ ", other_col, " * semantic_distance + ",
      "DefaultB_ns * semantic_distance + (1|Subject) + (1|stim_file)"
    )),
    data = df_wide
  )

  bind_rows(
    get_coef(m_dmnb_adj,    "DefaultB_ns", "DMN-B",     paste0("Adj_", other_label), paste0("DMN-B_Adj_", other_label)),
    get_coef(m_other_alone, other_col,     other_label, "Unadjusted",                paste0(other_label, "_Unadjusted")),
    get_coef(m_other_adj,   other_col,     other_label, "Adjusted",                  paste0(other_label, "_Adjusted"))
  ) %>%
    mutate(comparison = other_label)
})

# Top row
dmnb_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  dmnb_unadj %>%
    mutate(x_pos = 1, se = std.error, pattern_type = "none", fill_col = "#dc2d2c"),
  results %>%
    filter(network == "DMN-B") %>%
    rename(se = std.error) %>%
    mutate(
      x_pos = case_when(
        comparison == "FPN-A" ~ 2,
        comparison == "FPN-B" ~ 3,
        comparison == "VAN-B" ~ 4
      ),
      pattern_type = "stripe",
      fill_col     = "#dc2d2c"
    )
)

# Bottom row
other_plot_data <- results %>%
  filter(network != "DMN-B") %>%
  rename(se = std.error) %>%
  mutate(
    model    = factor(model, levels = c("Unadjusted", "Adjusted")),
    network  = factor(network, levels = c("FPN-A", "FPN-B", "VAN-B")),
    fill_col = case_when(
      network == "FPN-A" ~ "#8a5914",
      network == "FPN-B" ~ "#b8761b",
      network == "VAN-B" ~ "#f028e9"
    ),
    pattern_type = ifelse(model == "Adjusted", "stripe", "none"),
    x_pos = case_when(
      network == "FPN-A" ~ 2,
      network == "FPN-B" ~ 3,
      network == "VAN-B" ~ 4
    ),
    x_dodge = x_pos + ifelse(model == "Unadjusted", -0.15, 0.15)
  )



all_vals <- bind_rows(
  dmnb_plot_data %>% dplyr::select(estimate, se),
  other_plot_data %>% dplyr::select(estimate, se)
)
y_lo <- min(all_vals$estimate - all_vals$se)
y_hi <- max(all_vals$estimate + all_vals$se)
pad  <- 0.12 * (y_hi - y_lo)
y_limits <- c(min(y_lo - pad, 0), max(y_hi + pad, 0))

cat(sprintf("\ny-axis limits: [%.3f, %.3f]\n", y_limits[1], y_limits[2]))

y_lab <- expression(beta ~ "(neural shift × semantic distance)")

base_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio     = 1,
    text             = element_text(family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

col_layer <- geom_col_pattern(
  width             = 0.25,
  alpha             = 0.85,
  linewidth         = 0.4,
  color             = "grey20",
  pattern_fill      = "white",
  pattern_colour    = "white",
  pattern_spacing   = 0.06,
  pattern_density   = 0.3,
  pattern_linewidth = 0.3
)

row1 <- ggplot(dmnb_plot_data, aes(
    x = x_pos, y = estimate, fill = fill_col,
    pattern = pattern_type, group = x_pos
  )) +
  col_layer +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - se, ymax = estimate + se),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_pattern_manual(values = c("none" = "none", "stripe" = "stripe")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +            # zoom, do not drop data
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("Unadjusted", "adj. for\nFPN-A", "adj. for\nFPN-B", "adj. for\nVAN-B"),
    limits = c(0.5, 4.5)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab, title = "DMN-B") +
  base_theme +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

row2 <- ggplot(other_plot_data, aes(
    x = x_dodge, y = estimate, fill = fill_col,
    pattern = pattern_type, group = interaction(network, model)
  )) +
  col_layer +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - se, ymax = estimate + se, x = x_dodge),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_pattern_manual(values = c("none" = "none", "stripe" = "stripe")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("", "FPN-A", "FPN-B", "VAN-B"),
    limits = c(0.5, 4.5)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))



figure <- row1 / row2 + plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1.2))
figure

ggsave(
  filename = "../../results/reinterpretation_plots/stability_combined_LINEAR.png",
  plot     = figure,
  width    = 3.5,
  height   = 4.5,
  dpi      = 300
)

#SUMMARY!!
cat("\n=== LINEAR semantic distance: all extracted coefficients ===\n")
bind_rows(dmnb_plot_data, other_plot_data) %>%
  transmute(network, model,
            beta = round(estimate, 4),
            SE   = round(se, 4),
            t    = round(statistic, 2),
            p    = signif(p.value, 3),
            sig  = ifelse(p.value < .001, "***",
                   ifelse(p.value < .01,  "**",
                   ifelse(p.value < .05,  "*", "")))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)


```
